propositions: outbound_links.py imports adapters.jira vendor translation code directly, violating core neutrality (epic bbf1 AC3 and ADR 0035 §(d))
link diffing compares vendor link-type shapes in core instead of canonical relation vocabulary, coupling core to Jira's issuelinks schema
map_remote_links and link_payload_for_relation methods must be added to SupportsLinks capability to move vendor translation to the adapter boundary
core _diff_links/_diff_link_removals must compare local ticket deps against a canonical link set, with opaque vendor-type passengers preserved for REMOVE payloads
ADD dedup must remain direction-agnostic, matching local deps against remote links via (opaque_vendor_type, remote_key) pairs regardless of inward/outward direction
outbound_differ.py must pass the configured backend's SupportsLinks capability to _diff_links so canonical comparison is translation-mediated
